newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs down following losses on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs down following losses on NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices fell in quiet to moderate activity on Monday following Friday's sharp lossees on NYMEX crude futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane was down a half cent to between 34.25 cents and 34.50 cents a gallon, with 34.50 cents done.
Conway, Kansas, hub material traded several times at 35.75 cents, a penny below midday Friday.
"It's mostly the Merc. Demand is soft," said a Conway trader.
The butane and ethane markets were also about a quarter to half cent weaker.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
